text:
Alex: Heads-up — saw a ~12% drop in prefix cache global hitrate this morning, mostly affecting gpt-open-13b on prod routes.
Maria: Where in the stack? kernel selection, batching tweaks, or cache keying drift?
Josh: I pulled a quick profile. Kernel-selection churn jumped after the deploy: some requests flipped to tiled-matmul-v2 for seq_len >= 512, which increases per-token latency and seems to disable an optimization in our KV path.
Olivia: We did push a batching heuristic tweak yesterday (dynamic-window sizing). Could be interacting with tiled kernel decisions.
PerfBot: ALERT: prefix-cache-hitrate drop > 10% for model=gpt-open-13b in prod across regions. Dash: https://dash.redwood.ai/p/prefix-hitrate?run=3123 (sampling links attached)
Alex: KV miss rate increased on the same window. Route slices show AcmeCorp and a few smaller tenants are the biggest contributors. Token-saved delta: -40k tokens/min on that cohort.
Josh: Quick query I'm running:
```
select route, model, sum(missed_tokens) as miss_tokens
from prefix_cache_metrics
where ts > now() - interval '2 hours'
group by route,model
order by miss_tokens desc
```
Maria: Oh — PR #482 changed our key normalizer to hash_v3 (whitespace normalization tweak). That could change which cached prefixes match.
Olivia: If key normalization changed, warmstart won't hit previous keys. We can re-run the warmstart job with the old normalizer as an experiment.
Alex: I made a temp panel with per-model/per-route/per-customer token-saved waterfall and a heatmap for hitrate delta. Link: https://dash.redwood.ai/s/quick-warmstart-3123
Josh: Plan: run A/B canary comparing tiled-matmul-v2 vs tiled-matmul-v1 kernel selection (2h window), and re-run the kv warmup with hash_v2 normalizer. I'll capture token-saved and end-to-end p50/p95.
Tobi: SRE note: if we roll kernel flags, watch conductor CPU and GPU queue depth. Raise pager if latency > 20% for more than 5m.
Maria: Also enable a small sampling log of mismatched keys (1/1000) so we can inspect raw text differences that cause misses.
Alex: Assignments: Josh (owner, run experiments), Olivia (assist + warmstart), Maria (validate normalization diff and log sampling). Target: initial results by EOD.
PerfBot: Incident created: perf-regression-3123; ticket INF-2310. Patch branches linked.
Olivia: :thumbsup: I'll document steps and link run artifacts to INF-2310.
Josh: Starting canary now, will post incremental stats to this thread. If anyone sees anything odd ping me @josh.
Alex: Thanks — if the regression is keying-driven we should be able to recover quickly by reverting normalizer and re-warming. If it's kernel interaction, plan B is kernel rollback + rolling warmstart.
Maria: Adding a dashboardable metric: percent-of-misses-caused-by-key-normalization-change. Will PR a small exporter.
Tobi: I'll add a temporary alert for GPU queue latency and increase retention on prefix metrics for the next 24h.
Alex: Good. Keep updates brief here.
